what: Planned drift-baseline writes use a bare [[ ! -f ]] guard and redirection instead of the existing symlink-safe result-env writer
scenario_or_breakage: A broken symlink or non-regular $DESIGN_TMPDIR/drift-baseline.env passes the proposed guard; redirection can follow the symlink outside the design tmpdir or abort Step 2b on a directory even though drift is a non-critical guard
suggested_fix: Use the existing phase_driver_write_result_env pattern for drift-baseline.env and guard with [[ -e "$baseline" || -L "$baseline" ]] before the write; if an existing baseline is non-regular or unreadable, warn and treat drift as disabled rather than overwriting or aborting
